_comment: 来源：mod 仓库 _docs/data/lords/水师提督/水师提督角色与数值.md与 水师提督技能树.md（三种变体的树除坐骑与天生特性外完全相同，tree 取第一席 admiral-01）；desc / story 取 loc 中英原文（unit_description_*_texts）。

desc.zh: 水师提督统率艨艟斗舰，碧帆所到之处，便是震旦的海疆。
desc.en: A Fleet Admiral commands Cathay's war-junks, and wherever the jade sails reach, there the seas of Cathay begin.

story.zh: 震旦有一句老话：长垣的尽头不是海，海本身就是另一道长垣。水师提督便是这道海上长垣的守御者。碧帆之下，艨艟列阵如城垛，舰与舰之间的海面就是墙垣，海盗与深海妖物一视同仁——凡越过这道线的，都不会有第二次机会。但一位提督要面对的不只是敌人。风暴会拆散舰队，海流会拖偏航向，远航的水手会在第三个月开始怀疑自己为什么还在这里。舰队不散，是因为旗舰没有转向；旗舰没有转向，是因为海上的任何风浪都无法让站在船首的那个人动摇。
story.en: Cathay has an old saying: the Great Bastion does not end where the sea begins, for the sea is itself another Great Bastion. The Fleet Admiral is the warden of that bastion upon the water. Beneath the jade sails the war-junks stand in line like merlons, and the water between one hull and the next is the wall itself; pirates and monsters of the deep are held to the same measure, and none who crosses that line is given a second chance. But an admiral has more than the enemy to contend with. Storms scatter a fleet, currents drag a course astray, and by the third month at sea the crews begin to wonder why they are still out here at all. The fleet holds together because the flagship has not turned; and the flagship has not turned because nothing the sea can raise will move the one standing at her prow.

v.en: Lord (generic)

v.en: Champion and commander: naval spear, best against large targets

v.zh: 领主招募面板「水师提督」页签；每控制一座主要港口解锁一位
v.en: The Fleet Admiral tab of the lord recruitment panel; one unlocked for every major port you hold

v.zh: 无上限，取决于控制的主要港口数
v.en: No cap beyond the major ports you hold
82 run / 105 fly
115 run / 133 fly

note.zh: 三个形态各自独立，装备坐骑即整体切换，数值不叠加；三者共用同一杆长枪，无远程武器。徒步：鼓舞、抵御冲锋、于森林中隐蔽；两个骑乘形态：鼓舞、可以飞行、引发恐惧，骑海龙马另有形态被动「踏浪惊涛」。
note.en: Three separate forms: equipping a mount switches the whole profile, nothing stacks. All three use the same spear and have no missile weapon. On foot he encourages, resists charges and can hide in forests; mounted he encourages, flies and causes fear, and on the Sea Longma he also gains the Wake of Breaking Waves passive.

v.zh: 对大型目标 +25；三个形态共用同一杆枪。不带魔法攻击，技能树里也没有一格补上——对上高魔抗目标是这一档的短板
v.en: Bonus vs large +25; the same spear in all three forms. It is not magical, and no skill makes it so – targets with high magic resistance are this lord's weak spot

k.zh: 玉龙马（角色等级 10 自动获得）

v.zh: 飞行坐骑：护甲 100→110、冲锋 30→70、生命值 +1212，近战防御与武器威力不变；速度升至 82（跑）／105（飞）；获得飞行与引发恐惧，失去抵御冲锋与森林隐蔽
v.en: A flying mount: armour 100 → 110, charge 30 → 70, health +1212, melee defence and weapon strength unchanged; speed up to 82 run / 105 fly. Gains flight and Causes Fear, loses charge defence and Hide (forest)

k.zh: 海龙马（角色等级 19 自动获得）

v.zh: 终极飞行坐骑：近战攻击 56→58、冲锋 30→90、生命值 +1712，武器威力升至 130／300；速度升至 115（跑）／133（飞）；其余差异同玉龙马，另获得形态被动「踏浪惊涛」
v.en: His finest flying mount: melee attack 56 → 58, charge 30 → 90, health +1712, weapon strength up to 130 / 300; speed up to 115 run / 133 fly. Otherwise as the Jade Longma, plus the Wake of Breaking Waves passive

v.en: Allies within his aura gain leadership +4 (the standard vanilla Cathay lord passive)

v.zh: 单模型单位的原版通用被动：生命值低于 25% 时武器威力 −20%、移速 −10%
v.en: The standard vanilla passive for single-entity units: below 25% health, weapon strength −20% and speed −10%

v.zh: 陷入近战后开始充能：首次约 15 秒，此后每 20 秒向身前掀起一次浪涌，每次造成 22 点伤害（其中 7 点破甲）；只伤敌，不误伤友军；脱离近战即停止充能
v.en: Charges up once he is in melee: after about 15 seconds, and then every 20 seconds, he raises a surge of water in front of him for 22 damage (7 of it armour-piercing). It hits only enemies, and stops charging when he leaves melee

v.zh: 半径 35 米内友军近战防御 +5、远程抗性 +5%（原版昊天将军同款）
v.en: Allies within 35 m gain melee defence +5 and missile resistance +5% (as on the vanilla Celestial General)

form.zh: 被动 · 技能树「身先士卒」解锁
form.en: Passive · from the Lead from the Front skill

v.zh: 全军所有单位获得先锋部署属性（与原版经略使同名技能同款）；「兵法韬略」是个人线末端的孤立节点，23 级解锁
v.en: Every unit in his army gains Vanguard Deployment (as from the Lord Magistrate's skill of the same name). The Art of War is a standalone node at the end of his unique line, open from rank 23

form.zh: 全军 · 技能树「兵法韬略」解锁
form.en: Whole army · from The Art of War skill

v.zh: 指定地面目标，2 秒后落下一轮 18 发炮弹；每场 3 次，冷却 120 秒
v.en: Target a point on the ground; 2 seconds later a salvo of 18 cannonballs comes down on it. 3 uses per battle, cooldown 120 seconds

form.zh: 主动 · 技能树起点「水师枪术」解锁
form.en: Active · from Naval Spearmanship, the first unique skill

v.en: A whirling sweep around himself lasting 4 seconds; cooldown 120 seconds, unlimited uses (a copy of the vanilla Celestial Sweep)

form.zh: 主动 · 技能树「一枪横江」解锁
form.en: Active · from One Sweep Across the River

v.zh: 全形态；领导力光环
v.en: All forms; leadership aura

v.zh: 全形态，随变体固定：先登、驭潮为阳，炮令为阴。计入所在军队的宁和，与玉海潮勇、云霄禁卫（阳）及潮汐禁卫、舰队铳手、沧溟巨炮（阴）同一套
v.en: All forms, fixed by variant: First Aboard and Tide-Reader are Yang, Order to Fire is Yin. Counts towards his army's Harmony alongside the Jade Sea Warriors and Empyrean Guard (Yang) and the Tide Guard, Fleet Gunners and Abyssal Grand Cannon (Yin)

v.zh: 全形态；照原版泛用震旦领主的档次（和谐放大 150%），与沈长风相同
v.en: All forms; the standard rate for a generic Cathay lord, the same as Shen Changfeng

note.zh: 只列本 mod 原创的节点。原版复用的军团、战役与战斗三条线不列；三种变体的技能树相同，只有两匹坐骑的外观与天生特性（见上）不同。
note.en: Only this mod's own nodes are listed. The vanilla army, campaign and combat lines are left out. All three variants share the same tree; only the mounts' looks and the innate trait above differ.

sub.zh: 起点「水师枪术」9 级解锁，附带主动技「舷侧齐射」；其后四格——接舷战法、铳炮教习、引航之术、市舶之利——可各自点出，四格全点才能取「龙骧舟师」。「兵法韬略」是末端的孤立节点，23 级解锁，不需要前面的节点。
sub.en: Naval Spearmanship opens at rank 9 and brings the Broadside ability. The four after it – Boarding Tactics, Gunnery Instruction, The Pilot's Art and Maritime Trade – can be taken in any order, and all four are needed for The Dragon-Prowed Fleet. The Art of War is a standalone node at the end, open from rank 23 and needing nothing before it.

sub.zh: 他自己的近战武力：「破浪枪势」13 级解锁，接「一枪横江」；「身先士卒」是 11 级解锁的孤立节点。
sub.en: His own fighting power: Wave-Breaking Spearwork opens at rank 13 and leads into One Sweep Across the River; Lead from the Front is a standalone node from rank 11.

sub.zh: 原版战役线里被换掉的一格，只有「提督威名」是本 mod 的。
sub.en: The standard vanilla campaign line, with one node swapped out. Only Admiral's Renown is this mod's.

sub.zh: 两匹坐骑到等级自动获得：玉龙马 10 级、海龙马 19 级。「登峰造极」36 级开放，共 100 级、每级生命值 +1%，用来存放多出来的技能点。
sub.en: Both mounts arrive on their own: the Jade Longma at rank 10, the Sea Longma at rank 19. Beyond the Summit opens at rank 36 and has 100 levels of +1% health each, a place for surplus skill points.
